_comment: combat_cover_v1 plus intent_bonus: the same fight, but what counts as good depends on the intent in force. Under `retreat` the kill and damage_dealt terms are scaled to zero inside rewards.py (INTENT_COMBAT_SCALE) — v1 taught the controller that killing pays whatever it was told, which is why 'retreat' produced the fastest wipes. Every key is spelled out because --reward-json merges onto RewardConfig defaults, not onto this file.
